enabled.description: Enable or disable automatic display manager startup on boot.

user.description: Username to automatically log in. Must exist on the system.

minimum_uid.description: Minimum UID required for a user to be eligible for auto-login (prevents system accounts from auto-logging in).

xsession.description: Command or script to execute as the user session (e.g., desktop environment launcher).

xserver_options.description: Command-line arguments passed to the X server when starting (e.g., display number, virtual terminal, security options).

initialize_delay.description: Number of seconds to wait before attempting to auto-login (allows X server to fully initialize).

max_startup_time.description: Maximum seconds to wait for the user session to appear before giving up and restarting.

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file used by nodm for process tracking.

environment.description: List of custom environment variables to export before launching the session.
